description: This file handles server-side rendering requests for a Remix-based web application, distinguishing between bot and browser clients, setting appropriate response headers, and streaming the response back to the client.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main entry point for handling HTTP requests, routing between bot and browser rendering strategies based on user-agent.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering optimized for bots, streams the HTML response.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering optimized for browsers, streams the HTML response.
